services.name: Classic Whale & Dolphin Watching
services.desc: Say goodbye to the crowds and hello to a smaller, more personalized experience, where everyone has a front row seat Please try to book 24 hrs in advance! You don't want to miss out by booking too late. Your adventure begins the moment you step on board our expedition boat, because this is no ordinary whale watching trip. Whales, dolphins, sea lions and more are sighted on most days, depending on the season. Our small fast boat gets you out there quickly so you spend less time hunting and more time watching! More Info Life Jackets are provided What to wear Soft Soled Shoes (Walking shoes, 2.5 Hour Tour • 2-6 People • Aboard our Zodiac RIB

services.name: Premier Whale & Dolphin Watching
services.desc: A 3.5-hour small-group whale-watching expedition from San Diego offering expert narration and refreshments for up to six guests. 3.5 Hour Tour • Aboard our NEW vessel • Sea Fox 248 Commander

services.name: Ultimate Whale & Dolphin Watching
services.desc: A summer-only, 5–6 hour small-group deep-sea whale and dolphin watching expedition with expert commentary and onboard refreshments. 5-6 Hour Tour • Offered only during the summer • Sea Fox 248 Commander

includes: GRATUITIES are not included in the price, but are always welcome. We look forward to you joining us on an adventure of a lifetime!
gap: Cancellation Policy: 48 Hours If you cancel a trip LESS than 48 hours, the full amount will be charged to your card and the credit card receipt will be mailed to you.
